root_cause.text: The USB framework unanchors a URB before its completion callback, but ems_usb_read_bulk_callback() did not re-anchor the URB before resubmitting it, causing completed URBs to be absent from the dev->rx_submitted anchor list and thus never freed by usb_kill_anchored_urbs() during device close, resulting in a memory leak.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states: "the USB framework unanchors the URB before the complete function is called. This means that once an in-URB has been completed, it is no longer anchored and is ultimately not released in ems_usb_close()." The patch adds `usb_anchor_urb(urb, &dev->rx_submitted)` in the callback before resubmission, along with proper error handling using `usb_unanchor_urb()`.

bic_trace_step.reason: In ems_usb_read_bulk_callback(), the URB is resubmitted via usb_submit_urb() without calling usb_anchor_urb() to re-anchor it to dev->rx_submitted. Per the USB framework, the URB is unanchored before the completion callback, so this omission means the resubmitted URB is not on the anchor list. Consequently, usb_kill_anchored_urbs() during close/disconnect will not find it, leading to a memory leak. The fix would be to add 'usb_anchor_urb(urb, &dev->rx_submitted);' before usb_submit_urb().
